issue_context.title: Code generated by Json source generator results in warnings in projects with nullable enabled
issue_context.body:
I think it's an issue with the nullability annotations on the getters and setters for [JsonMetadataServices.CreatePropertyInfo](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/Metadata/JsonMetadataServices.cs#L26-L27)

These should be:

```diff
- Func<object, T>? getter,
+ Func<object, T?>? getter,
```

etc

Aren't the warnings correct in this case, because System.Text.Json ignores the non-nullability?

> Aren't the warnings correct in this case, because System.Text.Json ignores the non-nullability?

There's robust logic in STJ to handle `null` on serialization and deserialization, including to support features like ignoring `null` on serialization. Because of this we don't leak `NullReferenceException` and related bugs. However, it would be most correct to accept `T?` on deserialization and return `T?` on serialization, since property values could indeed be `null`. Unfortunately, I couldn't find a way to express this in a [prototype](https://github.com/layomia/dotnet_runtime/commit/6bbf1b640889bec36a531912aa90bdd226380c51#) to have the correct semantics, due [error CS0453](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/misc/cs0453?f1url=%3FappId%3Droslyn%26k%3Dk(CS0453)) given [this code](https://github.com/layomia/dotnet_runtime/commit/6bbf1b640889bec36a531912aa90bdd226380c51#diff-c0e6bc47405dcd7e6920cb0f76f369ef6a99a7ffca192e9cc581dbcfb6e01c8eR269-R270).

In the fix for the issue https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/57178, I left the parameter type as `Func<object, T>? getter` and just [banged](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/57178/files#diff-b7da6b90947be2bdebc35f367d9dc2c5bb66dd3be881af8a2d6cbb9c18108a7fR659) the return value of the getter call in the generated code.

`Get` is already declared as:

```C#
internal Func<object, T>? Get { get; set; }
```

Why is the `!` necessary here?

```suggestion
                Get = getter;
```
It is necessary to assign a value of type `Func<object, T?>?` to a property of type `Func<object, T>?`.
Shouldn't the property be changed to `Func<object, T?>?` then?
I tried to change it, but ran into issues - https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/57178#discussion_r687152012. The current implementation is a workaround.
